about.heading: Curiosity, made useful.
about.statement: Good technology makes the complicated feel possible.
paragraphs: I'm a B.Tech Artificial Intelligence & Data Science student at R.M.K. College of Engineering & Technology in Chennai. I enjoy the whole path from a difficult question to an experience someone can understand and use.

My work moves between machine learning, evidence-grounded agents and full-stack engineering. Recent projects explore inherited-risk education, safer agriculture, exoplanet detection and document intelligence.
I care about clear explanations, privacy, reproducibility and human judgement. A fictional demo, a prototype and an operational product deserve different claims, and I keep those boundaries visible.
points: B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science, R.M.K. College of Engineering & Technology.
Building AI agents, machine-learning systems and full-stack applications.
Exploring healthcare, agriculture, space science and document intelligence.

projects.title: KinSight — Inherited-Risk Navigator
projects.description: A multilingual screening-result navigator with couple consent, a counsellor console, referrals and a chat/voice assistant. Seven languages, accessible explanations and a traceable audit trail; all people and results are synthetic.
projects.imageAlt: KinSight concept illustration, not a screenshot of the application
points: Seven-language screening navigator with consent, referrals and a counsellor console.
Chat/voice guidance and traceable audit trail; all people and results are synthetic.

projects.title: Solarda — Agentic Smart Agriculture
projects.description: LangGraph farm agents combine irrigation planning, plant-disease vision, sensor forecasting and a six-language Gemini assistant. A deterministic safety engine and human approval govern actions. Uses replayed data; the hosted preview needs a backend for agent features.
projects.imageAlt: Solarda concept illustration, not a screenshot of the application
points: Farm agents for irrigation, disease vision and sensor forecasting.
Human approval and safety checks; hosted UI uses replayed data and needs a backend for agent features.

projects.title: ExoDetect — Exoplanet Detection
projects.description: Kepler light-curve processing, transit features and a calibrated XGBoost classifier for the ISRO Bhartiya Antariksh Hackathon 2026. The dashboard runs exported ONNX inference in the browser; heavy light-curve analysis stays in Python.
projects.imageAlt: ExoDetect concept illustration, not a screenshot of the application
points: Kepler light-curve features and calibrated XGBoost classification.
Browser ONNX inference; heavy light-curve analysis remains in Python.

projects.title: Legal & Regulatory Assurance Platform
projects.description: An evidence-first platform for contract intelligence, regulatory change and compliance workflows. Source provenance, scoped access and human review form the foundation; integrated legal analysis and summary workflows remain in development.
projects.imageAlt: Legal intelligence concept illustration, not a screenshot of the application
points: Document intelligence for legal research and analysis.
In development; inspect the source for current capabilities.

projects.title: eRTMAC-NWIS — Nearby Wells Intelligence
projects.description: Nearby-well search, formation correlation and evidence-grounded drilling advisories using PostGIS, local retrieval and LangGraph. Built for SIH 2026 problem SIH26121 with synthetic data and replayed telemetry; advisory-only, with an engineer making decisions.
projects.imageAlt: Nearby wells concept illustration, not a screenshot of the application
points: Geospatial groundwater intelligence and advisory exploration.
Synthetic-data prototype; not an operational decision system.

projects.title: EduNova — Gamified Science Learning
projects.description: Story-driven biology, chemistry and physics learning worlds with video quests, quizzes and a parent/teacher portal. Interactive Three.js scenes and React Three Fiber shaders support the learning experience.
projects.imageAlt: EduNova concept illustration, not a screenshot of the application
points: Biology, chemistry and physics worlds with video quests and quizzes.
Interactive Three.js/R3F scenes, plus parent and teacher views.

projects.title: Sri Ambal Healthcare
projects.description: A multi-specialty hospital website with a doctor directory, gallery, appointment booking, Gemini chatbot and WhatsApp confirmation flow. Built with Supabase and Google Sheets integrations.

projects.title: ResumeForge AI
projects.description: AI-powered resume-builder work with a LangGraph agent pipeline, resume generation and a Next.js interface. The public resume-io repository contains the resume-builder source.

projects.title: PeopleRamp — AI Onboarding
projects.description: Personalized employee onboarding built at a Siruseri hackathon, exploring voice, text and camera interactions.

projects.title: GhostIQ — Ghosting Score
projects.description: An AI-powered project exploring behavioural patterns and ghosting scores with a React interface and Gemini integration.

projects.title: SentinelPay — UPI Fraud AI
projects.description: A UPI fraud-detection project exploring Gemini-assisted transaction risk scoring, with a React interface and Node.js backend.

projects.title: OnboardIQ — AI Onboarding Platform
projects.description: An employee-onboarding platform with AI-generated plans, a chatbot, authentication and 30-60-90 day progress tracking, plus a Three.js landing page.

projects.title: Amazon Sales — Power BI Dashboard
projects.description: Cleaned Amazon sales data and built interactive dashboards with KPIs, trend charts, regional breakdowns and category performance insights.
